lines.text: I still sleep on the left, still face the door for you
Still make the coffee strong the way you liked me to
Morning finds me reaching where your body used to lie
I pull your pillow closer but it doesn’t feel like mine
And everybody says that time will mend
But I keep starting over at the end
I'm still living on your side of the bed
Loving all the quiet words we never said
Everybody's moving on, but I don't know how
I'm still holding onto you somehow
Your jacket’s on the chair, I haven’t moved it since that night
I regret the things I said that made you say goodbye
The house remembers you in every quiet room
I water all your plants and wait for them to bloom
And everybody says that time will mend
But I keep starting over at the end
I'm still living on your side of the bed
Loving all the quiet words we never said
Everybody's moving on, but I don't know how
I'm still holding onto you somehow
Still here… still yours… come home…
Maybe letting go is what the brave ones do
But I was never brave when it came to you
I'm still living on your side of the bed
Loving all the quiet words we never said
Everybody's moving on, but I don't know how
I'm still holding onto you somehow
